questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the handling of official Dak:
options_english: Open confidential Dak in the central registry before sending it to the concerned officer.
Stamp all incoming physical communications with the official date and receipt number upon entry.
Separate urgent and time-sensitive receipts immediately to process them on top priority.
Assign a unique diary reference number to systematically track each incoming document.
questions.explanation_english: Confidential or secret mail must not be opened by general central registry staff. Such receipts must be transmitted unopened in their original sealed covers directly to the addressee or authorized officer. General procedures apply only to open receipts, which are stamped with date and receipt numbers, prioritized if urgent, and assigned unique diary numbers for tracking.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। गोपनीय या रहस्य मेल को सामान्य केंद्रीय रजिस्ट्र्री के कर्मचारियों द्वारा नहीं खोला जाना चाहिए। ऐसे रसीदों को सीधे प्राप्तकर्ता या अधिकृत अधिकारी को उनके मूल सील किए गए कवर में बिना खोले भेजा जाना चाहिए। सामान्य प्रक्रियाएँ केवल खुले रसीदों पर लागू होती हैं, जिन्हें तिथि और प्राप्ति संख्या के साथ स्टाम्प किया जाता है, यदि तत्काल हो तो प्राथमिकता दी जाती है, और ट्रैकिंग के लिए अद्वितीय डायरी नंबर असाइन किए जाते हैं।

Printed answer key: (A) Open confidential Dak in the central registry

questions.question_english: In official correspondence, an “Office Memorandum” (O.M.) typically concludes with which of the following?
options_english: No complimentary close, just signature and designation.
The standard formal complimentary close “Yours faithfully” placed on the bottom right corner.
The semi-formal complimentary close “Yours sincerely” positioned right above the signature line.
An informal personalized closing phrase such
questions.explanation_english: An Office Memorandum is written in an impersonal third-person style and omits traditional salutations as well as complimentary closes such as Yours faithfully or Yours sincerely. It terminates directly after the main textual body, followed by the physical or digital signature, name, and official designation of the issuing officer.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एक ऑफिस मेमोरेन्डम एक निरपेक्ष तीसरे व्यक्ति की शैली में लिखा जाता है और इसमें पारंपरिक अभिवादन और सम्मानजनक समापन जैसे "आपका विश्वासपूर्वक" या "आपका सच्चे दिल से" शामिल नहीं होते हैं। यह मुख्य पाठ्य सामग्री के बाद सीधे समाप्त होता है, इसके बाद जारी करने वाले अधिकारी के भौतिक या डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर, नाम और आधिकारिक पदनाम होता है।
questions.topic: File Management Correspondence Noting and Drafting
key_facts: Office Memorandum omits traditional salutations and complimentary closes.
It concludes directly after the main body with the signature.
Printed answer key: (A) No complimentary close, just signature and designation.

questions.question_english: When a communication carries legal implications, such as a notice for disciplinary action against an employee, which mode of dispatch is legally most sound to prove delivery?
options_english: Under Certificate of Posting (UCP)
Registered Post with Acknowledgment Due (AD)
Ordinary Post
Unofficial handover to a colleague
questions.explanation_english: Registered Post with Acknowledgment Due provides legal proof of delivery, making it the standard dispatch mode for legally sensitive documents such as disciplinary notices. The signed acknowledgment receipt returned by the postal service serves as verifiable evidence in administrative or legal proceedings, ensuring that the addressee cannot deny receipt of the official communication.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। पंजीकृत डाक के साथ स्वीकृति कानूनी डिलीवरी का प्रमाण प्रदान करता है, जिससे यह अनुशासनात्मक नोटिस जैसे कानूनी संवेदनशील दस्तावेजों के लिए मानक प्रेषण मोड बन जाता है। डाक सेवा द्वारा लौटाया गया हस्ताक्षरित स्वीकृति रसीद प्रशासनिक या कानूनी कार्यवाही में सत्यापित साक्ष्य के रूप में कार्य करता है, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि प्राप्तकर्ता आधिकारिक संचार की प्राप्ति से इनकार नहीं कर सकता।
questions.topic: File Management Correspondence Noting and Drafting
key_facts: Registered Post with Acknowledgment Due is essential for legal communications.

questions.question_english: What is the standard procedure for dealing with a paper whose subject does not fall under the jurisdiction of your school/office, but has been mistakenly received in your Dak?
options_english: Shred or tear the misdirected document immediately and dispose of it in the office dustbin.
File the misdirected document inside a general miscellaneous folder and retain it permanently.

questions.explanation_english: When an office receives a communication whose subject matter falls outside its administrative jurisdiction, standard procedure prohibits discarding or permanently filing the document. The receipt must be transferred immediately to the correct department under advice to the sender, or returned directly to the sender to prevent processing delays.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। जब किसी कार्यालय को ऐसा संचार प्राप्त होता है जिसका विषय उसके प्रशासनिक अधिकार क्षेत्र से बाहर होता है, तो मानक प्रक्रिया दस्तावेज़ को नष्ट करने या स्थायी रूप से फाइल करने की अनुमति नहीं देती। प्राप्ति को तुरंत सही विभाग में स्थानांतरित किया जाना चाहिए या प्रेषक को सीधे वापस किया जाना चाहिए ताकि प्रक्रिया में देरी न हो।

questions.question_english: Under the classification of files, what does a “B” category file signify?
options_english: Records to be kept permanently but without being microfilmed/digitized.
Records of historical importance to be kept permanently.
Records to be retained for a specified period (e.g., 5 to 10 years) and then destroyed.
Routine records to be destroyed after one year.
questions.explanation_english: In file classification, Category B records consist of files having enduring administrative, historical, or legal value that must be preserved permanently in record rooms. Unlike Category A records, Category B files do not require microfilming or digitization, but they are retained indefinitely, distinguishing them from Category C files that have limited, specified retention periods.

questions.question_english: In official terminology, a “Routine Note” is best described as:
options_english: A detailed analytical study proposing major structural changes to a new government policy framework.
An executive decision summary written exclusively by and under the authority of the Head of Department.
A note on matters of a casual or routine nature like acknowledging a letter.
A strictly confidential strategic report regarding ongoing senior-level disciplinary proceedings.
questions.explanation_english: A Routine Note refers to brief procedural record-writing utilized for handling matters of casual, administrative, or repetitive character. Such notes do not require elaborate factual analysis, rule interpretation, or detailed policy evaluations. Common applications include recording simple acknowledgments, forwarding documents between branches, or processing standard administrative permissions, thereby expediting routine office workflow without generating excessive documentation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। रूटीन नोट आकस्मिक, प्रशासनिक, या दोहराव वाले मामलों को संभालने के लिए संक्षिप्त प्रक्रियात्मक रिकॉर्ड-लेखन को संदर्भित करता है। ऐसे नोट्स को विस्तृत तथ्यात्मक विश्लेषण, नियम व्याख्या, या विस्तृत नीति मूल्यांकन की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है। सामान्य अनुप्रयोगों में सरल स्वीकृतियों को रिकॉर्ड करना, शाखाओं के बीच दस्तावेज़ों को अग्रेषित करना, या मानक प्रशासनिक अनुमतियों को संसाधित करना शामिल है, जिससे बिना अत्यधिक दस्तावेज़ीकरण उत्पन्न किए रूटीन कार्यालय कार्यप्रवाह को तेज किया जा सके।
